verdict.rationale: Airwallex has a refunds doc page saying merchants 'can issue a refund to return their funds' when a shopper returns goods. That establishes basic refund capability. The snippet does not say whether partial refunds are supported, or whether refunds can be issued from the dashboard, the API, or both. Missing for 10: evidence of partial vs full refund amounts, evidence of dashboard refund workflow, evidence of a refund API endpoint, independent or hands-on corroboration.
